home.pocDesc: 30-day POC, deployment handled by our engineers. Security maturity report included.
home.threatContextP1: Threat actors now operate like businesses: specialized teams, commercial toolkits for hire, initial access purchased on darknet markets. The average lateral movement time after initial compromise has dropped below <1>19 minutes</1>.
home.threatContextP2: Siloed security tools — antivirus, legacy SIEM, standalone EDR — can no longer keep pace. You need a platform capable of <1>correlating, prioritizing, and acting</1> in seconds, not hours.
home.soarDesc: Our SOAR engine automatically orchestrates the response to the most common incidents — without human intervention for critical steps.
home.protectionDomainsDesc: From workstations to industrial OT, every layer of your infrastructure is covered by a native sensor.
home.capXdrDesc: Native correlation across endpoints, network, cloud, and identities. Single console, zero blind spots. Average MTTD reduction of 87%.
home.capAiDesc: Models trained on 10 years of real-world attacks. Signature-free anomaly detection, adaptive to each client's environment.
home.capZtDesc: Continuous verification of every access, every request, every identity. Dynamic micro-segmentation without infrastructure overhaul.
home.capTiDesc: Real-time access to indicators of compromise from 140 global sources. Automatic enrichment of every alert.
home.capCspmDesc: Continuous audit of your AWS, Azure, GCP configurations. Drift detection and policy enforcement before any incident.
home.capNdrDesc: East-west and north-south traffic analysis via deep packet inspection. Lateral movement detection invisible to legacy tools.
home.incidentConfinementDesc: Automatic isolation of the compromised asset
home.incidentRemediationDesc: Patch and restoration to clean state
home.testimonial1Quote: In six months, we reduced our attack surface by 60% and eliminated virtually all the false positives that were overwhelming our SOC.
home.testimonial2Quote: Deployment took 48 hours. The next day, the AI had detected a lateral movement that our previous EDR tools had missed.
home.archAgentDesc: Single agent for Windows, Linux, macOS endpoints. Memory footprint < 1%. Deployable via GPO, Ansible, or your orchestrator.
home.archCloudDesc: Infrastructure hosted in France (SecNumCloud). No data leaves European territory. Air-gap option available.
home.archAiDesc: Offline detection possible. The model runs locally — no cloud dependency for endpoint protection.
home.archScaleDesc: From 500 to 500,000 endpoints with no architecture change. The data lake scales horizontally without interruption.
home.archEncryptDesc: E2E encryption for data in transit and at rest. Encryption keys under your exclusive control (BYOK).
home.archApiDesc: Documented REST API, webhooks, Python SDK. Native integrations with ITSM, SOAR, SIEM, and market IdP.

legal.aboutDesc: CynaSecure is an XDR platform founded in Paris in 2019 by former DGSI and European CERT experts. Our conviction: the complexity of the threat landscape does not justify the complexity of the tools meant to address it.
legal.aboutOriginTitle: Born from frustration, built with method.
legal.aboutOriginP1: In 2018, CynaSecure's founders worked in SOCs of critical organizations. Every day, the same reality: dozens of poorly integrated tools, context-free alerts, exhausted analysts drowning in noise.
legal.aboutOriginP2: CynaSecure was born from this frustration — and a conviction: a unified platform, built around behavioral AI and native correlation, could radically improve the signal-to-noise ratio.
legal.aboutOriginP3: Since 2019, we have protected critical infrastructures across France and Europe. Our clients range from industrial mid-market companies to financial institutions and healthcare entities subject to HDS requirements.
legal.aboutCtaDesc: Our engineers respond within 4 business hours.
legal.valTransparenceText: We do not sell opaque security. Every detection, every alert, every algorithmic decision is explained — so your teams understand, not just endure.
legal.valSouveraineteText: Your data stays in France, on SecNumCloud infrastructure. No external access, no resale, no dependency on non-European actors.
legal.valEfficaciteText: A tool nobody uses protects nothing. Our obsession: reduce noise, prioritize signal, and make responses actionable in seconds.
legal.valPartenariatText: We don't walk away after deployment. A dedicated engineer, monthly posture reviews, human support — not a ticket to nowhere.
legal.timeline2019Desc: Five co-founders from DGSI, ANSSI and major European CERTs. First seed funding round of €3M.
legal.timeline2021Desc: First native XDR platform to obtain ANSSI PRIS qualification. Deployed at 50 critical organizations.
legal.timeline2023Desc: Expansion into Belgium, Germany and Spain. Launch of 24/7 managed SOC and OT/ICS coverage.
legal.timeline2025Desc: Launch of self-service platform. 140 experts. Infrastructure hosted in France, SecNumCloud certified.
legal.unofficialTranslation: This is an unofficial translation. The French version prevails in case of dispute.
